headline: Stonecradle Flares as Nevish Line Rekindles Action
war_summary: Since the last edition the wire has quickened in several quarters. Stonecradle reports seven changes in two hours, all seven on the day about The Reach and The Dais with holdings at one Warden, seven Colonial and one destroyed, while casualty rates accelerate. The Weathered Expanse adds five changes in two hours and thirty-one on the day about Crow's Nest, Shattered Advance and Frostmarch at two Warden to seven Colonial with heavy day losses. The Nevish Line is active again with four changes in two hours and seventeen on the day about Princefal at seven Warden to one Colonial alongside rising casualty rates. Callahan's Passage shows three changes in two hours and seventy-nine on the day about The Latch with all ten holdings Warden though hourly losses have cooled. Linn Mercy records three changes in two hours, six on the day at Lathair at one Warden to ten Colonial with sharply accelerating losses. Mooring County adds two changes in two hours, twelve on the day at The Wind Hills under twelve Warden holdings. Fisherman's Row and Viper Pit have gone quiet in the past two hours.
